scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env demo
scripts.seed:local: npm run seed:build && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --env demo --file seed/demo.sql
scripts.migrate:demo: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env demo
scripts.seed:demo: npm run seed:build && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env demo --file seed/demo.sql
scripts.migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
